title: July Edition: Newly Issued Patents
summary_en: Congratulations to Purdue Engineers who recently received patents on their intellectual property from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

title: ME's Choi builds synthetic DNA structure that demonstrates a jitterbug transformation
summary_en: Purdue University researchers have successfully built a 3D DNA origami structure that performs a “jitterbug transformation,” mimicking the same behavior that enables viruses to deploy their payloads in nature.
title_cn: ME's Choi builds synthetic DNA structure that demonstrates a jitterbug transformation

title: Engineering space to breath: ABE's Porterfield publishes research on respiration under microgravity
summary_en: Marshall Porterfield, professor of biological engineering and space biophysics at Purdue University, in an effort to solve a physical problem of space exploration, recently published research focusing on human respiration under microgravity.
title_cn: Engineering space to breath: ABE's Porterfield publishes research on respiration under microgravity
